entities.summary: Rocco Niccolas Grimaldi is an American professional ice hockey forward for SKA Saint Petersburg of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). Grimaldi was drafted in the second round, 33rd overall, by the Florida Panthers in the 2011 NHL entry draft.
